notes.title: Wishlist Silicone Heart now!
notes.notes:
[b]Silicone Heart is now on Steam!
[/b]
Hey everyone! We're thrilled to announce that our game Silicone Heart is now available to wishlist on Steam!

🎮 Why does it matter?
Your support will help our studio take the next step and bring the game's release closer to reality!

In Silicone Heart, you'll find yourself on a scrapyard planet ruled by robots 🤖:
- Pretend to be a robot to survive.
- Grow vegetables and trade them for "energy," the local currency.
- Become a mechanic-healer, repairing robots from scattered parts.

Each repaired robot brings you closer to uncovering the mysteries of the planet.

[b][u] Support us — wishlist the game now! [/u][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340880/Silicone_Heart/

notes.title: Community patch is out now!
notes.notes:
Dear players, we are excited to introduce the latest updates to our game, with gratitude for your feedback:

Correction of incorrect texture translations to ensure every detail of the world looks perfect. Now, the secrets hidden within the textures will become clearer!

Improved control responsiveness. Now, being chased by monsters will become even more thrilling!

We've adjusted the game's music volume. Let every note give you goosebumps!

Fixed processing for certain keys. Now, every move you make will be precise!

Added mouse sensitivity settings, ensuring each of your movements is even more precise and predictable.

Minor changes and improvements to make your adventure even more captivating.

Enhanced physics. Feel every rustle and every collision in the world of horrors!

Thank you for joining our mystical journey! Don't forget to count your bullets.

notes.title: Bunker 21: Extended Edition is now available!
notes.notes:
Welcome to "Bunker 21: Extended Edition" - a dark adventure that will shake your mind and nerves!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082510/Bunker_21_Extended_Edition/

Humanity has vanished, leaving only darkness. You are the last survivor, seeking answers and hope in a desolate world. Secrets of the Apocalypse and horrifying revelations await you amidst the ruins of the past.

Prepare to confront monstrous mutants spawned from secret experiments. You'll need to use all your survival skills to withstand the nightmarish creatures lurking at every turn.

Fearlessly venture into other dimensions through mysterious portals awaiting you in the darkness. Each step will be a trial, and only the bravest will find a way out of this nightmare.

Embark on an immersive narrative journey, where enigmatic characters and puzzles will be your companions. Your survival depends on your ability to unravel mysteries and confront horrors.

Are you ready to plunge into the horror of "Bunker 21: Extended Edition"? Brace yourself for a terrifying journey and face your darkest nightmares. The full horror awaits you inside...
